purpose: Classify how strongly an institutional-flow observation can be interpreted as ordinary active flow when point-in-time index/passive-event context is or is not available.

requirements: complete PIT passive-event coverage for the relevant event universe
no applicable index/passive event in frozen event window
states.interpretation: ordinary-flow context is supported; this does not prove active fundamental conviction

requirements: observation lies in frozen announced/effective/post-effective event phase
states.interpretation: institutional flow is event-conditioned and must not be interpreted as independent conviction without incremental evidence

requirements: verified overlapping index events or derivatives-expiry overlap
states.interpretation: mechanical-flow attribution is multi-causal; no single motive assigned
contamination status UNKNOWN; absence of an event row is not evidence of no event

requirements: TDCC concentration is the only ownership evidence
states.interpretation: 400-lot-plus ownership cannot identify passive/active/institutional holder motive

hardGuards: No state maps directly to BUY/SELL or score change.
No-event classification requires complete PIT event coverage; otherwise UNKNOWN.
Foreign buying near an index event is not automatically passive, and passive/mechanical flow is not automatically non-predictive.
Announcement and effective clocks remain distinct.
Multiple ETFs tracking one benchmark are exposure, not independent events.
Current ETF AUM cannot be backfilled to historical event dates.
TDCC ownership brackets cannot identify passive/index holders.
Do not create a duplicate passive-flow score inside institutionalScore.
falsification: PF-003/PF-019 show indexers and non-indexers can both trade around index events, so event overlap cannot identify every share as passive.
PF-012 states mechanical demand can have real and persistent price impact, so contamination is an interpretation/context flag, not a bearish veto.
PF-034 evidence build remains incomplete for deterministic constituent/AUM/effective-close coverage, so historical ordinary-flow classification cannot be broadly asserted.

integration.institutionalLaneRole: consume PIT event context; retain institutional flow as its own evidence family
integration.futureJoinKey: same Formal generation plus symbol and event first-known eligibility
integration.immutableParentRequirement: event child must attach to the same canonical Formal generation; later event knowledge cannot revise historical decision context

engineering.classA: pure taxonomy/observer and immutable research child once PIT event rows already exist
engineering.classB: shared runtime persistence/join wiring for event children or TDCC vintage

exactNext: Audit whether current Passive Flow source map can produce a complete negative-evidence denominator for any bounded provider/index/date universe. If not, define the smallest prospective PIT event receipt needed to distinguish NO_EVENT_VERIFIED from EVENT_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE. Keep outcomes closed and do not modify institutionalScore.
